facts.text: The SVSU Cardinal Commitment covers tuition for eligible new first-time students for up to five continuous years or until bachelor's degree completion.

sources.title: Cardinal Commitment - Saginaw Valley State University
sources.quote: The SVSU Cardinal Commitment covers tuition for new first-time-in-college students for up to five (5) continuous years or through completion of their first bachelor's degree, whichever is sooner, as long as the student continues to meet eligibility requirements.
